title: Debugging in plain English
tagline: Ask an FPGA on the board a question in words; get the waveform and a plain answer that quotes only the capture
description: A plain-English request becomes a probe plan by RTL name, an on-chip logic analyser build in Vivado 2026.1 on the free licence tier, a capture on a Digilent Nexys A7 and an answer checked against the captured samples.

facts.text: 5 of 5 plain-English requests answered from captures on the board, each matching the known result and the value read back over the serial link (one design, one run each).
1 of the requests needed no new build: an earlier debug build already held its signals (each new probe set otherwise took 7 to 9 minutes to build).
All 5 captures ran inside the recommended operating conditions, with 0 supply or temperature alarms.

media.alt: A recorded capture from the Nexys A7 replayed cycle by cycle: the write strobe, the address byte and the counter changing from 0x0003 to 0x1234 on the clock after the write, with the request, plan, build and answer as captions.
media.note: Recorded frame by frame from the showcase page's own hero, which replays one real run.

made_from: site/public/showcase/nl_debug.html (the hero player), captured by puppeteer and encoded with ffmpeg
